_doc: Claude API list prices in USD per million tokens, read by `fleet stats` for the Fleet tab's cost estimates. Seats aren't billed per token, so these turn transcript token counts into what the same work would cost on the API. Prices change: update a row (and its as_of/source) when Anthropic does. A model missing here shows no cost. cache_write_5m and cache_write_1h are the 5-minute and 1-hour cache-write prices (1.25x and 2x input).

claude-haiku-5-5.source: claude-api skill model table; cache_read estimated at 0.1x input (not listed); prompts over 100K tokens bill $0.50/$2.50
